text_en: But the Israelites broke faith in regard to the devoted things: Achan son of Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things; and the anger of the Lord burned against the Israelites.
text_cn: 以色列子民在应毁灭之物上犯了罪：那是因为犹大支派中，则辣黑的曾孙，匝贝狄的孙子，加尔米的儿子阿干，取了应毁灭之物，上主对以色列子民发了大怒。

text_en: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and said to them, “Go up and spy out the land. ” And the men went up and spied out Ai.
text_cn: 若苏厄从耶里哥派人到哈依去，──这城位于贝特耳东方贝特阿文附近── 吩咐他们说：“你们上去，侦察那地。”那些人便上去侦探了哈依。

text_en: Then they returned to Joshua and said to him, “Not all the people need go up; about two or three thousand men should go up and attack Ai. Since they are so few, do not make the whole people toil up there. ”
text_cn: 他们回来对若苏厄说：“不需要众百姓都上去，只派两三千人去攻打哈依就够了，不必劳动全体百姓，因为他们人数不多。”

text_en: So about three thousand of the people went up there; and they fled before the men of Ai.
text_cn: 这样，百姓中约有三千人上去攻打哈依，不料他们由哈依人面前逃跑了。

text_en: The men of Ai killed about thirty-six of them, chasing them from outside the gate as far as Shebarim and killing them on the slope. The hearts of the people melted and turned to water.
text_cn: 哈依人出击，杀了他们约有三十六人，从城门前追击他们，直追到舍巴陵，在斜坡上又杀败了他们，因此百姓的勇气像水一样消散了。

text_en: Then Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the ground on his face before the ark of the Lord until the evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
text_cn: 若苏厄撕破自己的衣服，和以色列人的长老，在上主约柜前俯伏在地，一直到晚上，各在头上撒上灰土。

text_en: Joshua said, “Ah, Lord God ! Why have you brought this people across the Jordan at all, to hand us over to the Amorites so as to destroy us? Would that we had been content to settle beyond the Jordan!
text_cn: 若苏厄说：“唉！我主上主！你为什么领这百姓渡过约但河，是为将我们交于阿摩黎人手中，让我们消灭吗？巴不得我们住在约但河那边倒好！

text_en: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has turned their backs to their enemies!
text_cn: 唉我主！以色列人既然由敌人前转身逃跑，我还说什么呢？

text_en: The Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. Then what will you do for your great name? ”
text_cn: 当客纳罕人和这地方所有的居民听说这事，必来围攻我们，从地上将我们的名字抹去，那时你对你的大名，要怎样办呢？”

text_en: The Lord said to Joshua, “Stand up! Why have you fallen upon your face?
text_cn: 上主对若苏厄说：“起来，为什么老是伏在地上？

text_en: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant that I imposed on them. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have acted deceitfully, and they have put them among their own belongings.
text_cn: 以色列犯了罪，违背了我在盟约上给他们规定的，取了应毁灭之物，又偷又骗，并将应毁灭之物放在自己行囊里。

text_en: Therefore the Israelites are unable to stand before their enemies; they turn their backs to their enemies, because they have become a thing devoted for destruction themselves. I will be with you no more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.
text_cn: 以色列子民所以抵挡不住敌人，由敌人前转身逃跑，是因为他们成了当诅咒的，除非你们将那应毁灭之物，由他们中间除掉，我不再与你们同在。

text_en: Proceed to sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow; for thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, “There are devoted things among you, O Israel; you will be unable to stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted things from among you. ”
text_cn: 起来，叫百姓圣洁自己，吩咐他们说：你们明天要圣洁自己，因为上主以色列的天主这样说：以色列！你们中间有应毁灭之物，除非将应毁灭之物，由你们中间除掉，你们决抵挡不住敌人。

text_en: In the morning therefore you shall come forward tribe by tribe. The tribe that the Lord takes shall come near by clans, the clan that the Lord takes shall come near by households, and the household that the Lord takes shall come near one by one.
text_cn: 所以明早你们应按支派前来。上主使那支派中签，这支派的宗族都应前来；上主使那宗族中签，这宗族的家室都应前来；上主使那家室中签，这家的男子应一个一个地前来。

text_en: And the one who is taken as having the devoted things shall be burned with fire, together with all that he has, for having transgressed the covenant of the Lord , and for having done an outrageous thing in Israel. ’”
text_cn: 若藏有应毁灭之物的人中了签，他和他所有的一切都应用火焚烧，因为他违犯了上主的约定，在以色列中间做了糊涂的事。”

text_en: So Joshua rose early in the morning, and brought Israel near tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
text_cn: 若苏厄清早起来，命以色列按着支派一一前来，犹大支派中了签。

text_en: He brought near the clans of Judah, and the clan of the Zerahites was taken; and he brought near the clan of the Zerahites, family by family, and Zabdi was taken.
text_cn: 他叫犹大支派前来，则辣黑宗族中了签；遂叫则辣黑宗族前来，匝贝狄家室中了签；

text_en: And he brought near his household one by one, and Achan son of Carmi son of Zabdi son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
text_cn: 此后，又叫他的家室前来，叫男丁一个一个地前来，阿干中了签，──阿干是加尔米的儿子，加尔米是匝贝狄的儿子，匝贝狄是则辣黑的儿子，属犹大支派。

text_en: Then Joshua said to Achan, “My son, give glory to the Lord God of Israel and make confession to him. Tell me now what you have done; do not hide it from me. ”
text_cn: 若苏厄遂对阿干说：“我儿！你应归光荣于上主，以色列的天主，向他认罪。请告诉我，你作了什么事，不要隐瞒我。”

text_en: And Achan answered Joshua, “It is true; I am the one who sinned against the Lord God of Israel. This is what I did:
text_cn: 阿干回答若苏厄说：“我实在得罪了上主，以色列的天主。我是如此这般作的：

text_en: when I saw among the spoil a beautiful mantle from Shinar, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, then I coveted them and took them. They now lie hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath. ”
text_cn: 我在战利品中，见了一件美丽的史纳尔外氅(chǎng)，二百‘协刻耳’银子，一条重五十‘协刻耳’的金条，我因贪爱便拿走了，现在藏在我帐幕中的地下，银子在这些东西下面。”

text_en: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there it was, hidden in his tent with the silver underneath.
text_cn: 若苏厄即刻派差役跑到他帐幕里面，果然那些东西在他帐幕内藏着，银子在下面。

text_en: They took them out of the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites; and they spread them out before the Lord .
text_cn: 差役便从帐幕里拿出来，带到若苏厄和所有以色列子民那里，摆在上主面前。

text_en: Then Joshua and all Israel with him took Achan son of Zerah, with the silver, the mantle, and the bar of gold, with his sons and daughters, with his oxen, donkeys, and sheep, and his tent and all that he had; and they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.
text_cn: 若苏厄和所有的以色列人，将则辣黑的曾孙阿干和那银子、外氅、金条，并他的子女、牛、驴、羊、帐幕，以及他所有的一切，都带到阿苛尔山谷。

text_en: Joshua said, “Why did you bring trouble on us? The Lord is bringing trouble on you today. ” And all Israel stoned him to death; they burned them with fire, cast stones on them,
text_cn: 若苏厄说：“你为什么给我们招来祸患？今天上主必要叫你遭祸。”以色列民众于是用石头将他砸死。众人用石头砸死他们以后，将一切用火烧了。

text_en: and raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his burning anger. Therefore that place to this day is called the Valley of Achor.
text_cn: 以后，又在阿干身上堆上了一大堆石头，这堆石头一直存到今日；上主于是撤回了盛怒。因此那地方直到今日叫做阿苛尔山谷。
